title: Spacious 4BR Townhome Near DT • Sleeps 8
description:
Experience Nashville’s Charm from Your Spacious Retreat! Just 10 minutes from Broadway, this home offers the perfect blend of downtown excitement and peaceful comfort. Enjoy easy $10 Uber/Lyft rides to Broadway, Demonbreun, live music venues, and other hotspots. Highlights include a fully equipped kitchen, a serene space for restful nights, and convenient access—only 11 miles from BNA Airport and 4 miles from Downtown Broadway. Your ideal base for exploring Nashville awaits!

The space
Dream Escape: Comfort & Style in Our 4BR, 2.5BA Home
Relax in a spacious retreat featuring 1 king bed, 2 queen beds, 2 twin XL bunk beds, and a cozy living room sofa. Enjoy the convenience of free parking on the large pad in front or plenty of street parking nearby. Your perfect blend of comfort and convenience awaits!

> Laundry Facilities: Enjoy the convenience of a washer and dryer within the condo for your laundry needs.
> Linens and Toiletries: We've got you covered with provided linens, towels, shampoo, conditioner, and soaps.
> Essentials for Your Stay: Toilet paper, paper towels, trash bags, and dish pods are provided for your stay. Please note that we do not replenish these items during longer stays.
> Coffee for Your Enjoyment: Coffee grounds are provided for your use. Brew a fresh cup to kickstart

Guest access
You have access to the entirety of the home!
